_what_this_is: This station's materials, in this station's own language. Two voices, one anchor, four materials. Every noun in this file is invented for the probe and appears in no other pack.

gasket_band.line: the welded gasket band above the deck
gasket_band.sentence: A clearly legible welded gasket band runs continuously corner to corner at exactly 1.20 m above the deck, on every exposed bulkhead surface including the side-wall returns.
gasket_band.label: GASKET BAND 1.20 M ABOVE DECK - GATE ANCHOR
gasket_band.why: This station's universal anchor: the one continuous horizontal every compartment of a pressure hull carries.

wet_lab_lined.why: The wet lab is the compartment that is worked in wet: its strakes are lined with a glazed ceramic wash so they can be hosed down, and it is the one compartment entitled to the painted hull crest.
wet_lab_lined.walls: riveted anodised bulkhead plate in vertical strakes, lined below the band with a pale glazed ceramic wash
wet_lab_lined.ceiling: a ribbed alloy overhead deck with recessed strip lume between the ribs
wet_lab_lined.floor: an open ribbed alloy deck grating over dark bilge water
wet_lab_lined.blank: unbroken riveted bulkhead plate in vertical strakes with its pale glazed ceramic wash below the band

pump_gallery_bare.why: The pump gallery is machinery space: bare anodised plate, no liner, no crest. It exists in this pack to prove that two compartments of one station can differ without either borrowing the other's paragraph.
pump_gallery_bare.walls: bare riveted anodised bulkhead plate in vertical strakes, unlined, with cable trays run above the band
pump_gallery_bare.ceiling: a ribbed alloy overhead deck with a single strip lume on the centreline
pump_gallery_bare.floor: an open ribbed alloy deck grating over dark bilge water
pump_gallery_bare.blank: unbroken bare riveted bulkhead plate in vertical strakes, unlined, with its cable trays above the band
